ov: طرزان (الإنجليزية: Tarzan) هو فلم رسوم متحركة أمريكي، أنتجته شركة والت ديزني في عام 1999.
plotEn:
In the 1890s, a British couple and their infant son are shipwrecked on the coast of equatorial West Africa. After building a tree house with parts salvaged from the wreckage, the couple are soon ambushed and killed by Sabor, a leopard. Kala, a gorilla who lost her own infant to Sabor, discovers the orphaned infant in the treehouse. She rescues him from Sabor and adopts him, naming him Tarzan.
As a child, Tarzan lives in the jungle with Kala, befriending her niece Terk, and the paranoid elephant Tantor. Tarzan finds himself treated differently by the gorillas, including Kerchak, the troop's stern leader and Kala's mate. When Tarzan accepts a dare from Terk, he accidentally triggers an elephant stampede. Infuriated, Kerchak declares Tarzan an outsider. With the help of Kala, Terk, and Tantor, Tarzan makes valiant efforts to improve himself as he grows. Years later, Tarzan saves Kerchak against Sabor's ambush and kills her, earning his reluctant respect.
Meanwhile, British explorer Archimedes Q. Porter, his daughter Jane, and their hunter escort Clayton arrive in Africa to study gorillas. Jane gets distracted by a baby baboon, and is chased by an entire troop, until a curious Tarzan rescues her. Comparing himself to Jane, Tarzan discovers that they are from the same species. He returns Jane to her camp, where Porter and Clayton both take an interest in him. Despite Kerchak's orders to stay away from the humans, Tarzan repeatedly visits the camp to know more about the human world
